worldcombat.skill.karatechop.summary: Throw a knife-hand chop with almost no wind-up: a very short blade path is laid toward the aim, and the first non-ally it meets takes a vertical white line at point-blank, cutting it open in a spray of chips. It is very short, single-target and cheap, and allies or walls in the path stop it first; the edge seeks the seam in armour so it loses less to defence and it lands critical hits more often.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.description: The chop deals %1$s contact damage to the first non-ally on its blade path and lands critical hits more often; it loses less to defence reduction than the rest of the family.
Reach %1$s blocks; an empty swing still completes the chop, and an ally body or a wall in the path stops it first.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.stance.knif: Knife-hand form: a heavier single hit, at shorter reach.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.stance.open: Open-hand form: longer reach, at a lighter single hit.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.growth.0: From level %1$s the chop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.growth.1: From level %1$s the chop rises to %2$s and reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.use.0: An instant knife-hand chop with no wind-up
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.use.1: One point-blank target, on a very short cooldown
worldcombat.skill.karatechop.use.2: An edge that seeks the seam in armour and crits more often
On (knife-hand): 110% power at 0.2 blocks shorter reach. Off (open-hand): +0.3 blocks reach at 92% power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of chopping; it is a point-blank move, so large values are unwise.
On: a target held by sleep, freeze or paralysis is chosen first for this chop. Off: it ranks as an ordinary melee strike.
On: below 35%% health a target raises this move's priority. Off: health is ignored.
